cases.name: scripts registered
cases.check: tool-catalog contains scout-fetch, scout-owned, scout-taxonomy and scout-health in the TARGET model's local catalog
cases.why: command lanes invoke by toolId and resolve per-model, local-first. An undeclared or globally-registered script leaves the lane failing at fire time, or silently running an older local entry that shadows it

cases.name: brief is required and non-consuming
cases.check: t-scout-fetch-cmd binds p-scout-brief with consume=false; a fire leaves the brief token in place
cases.why: a consuming config preset deletes the investigation definition on the first fire

cases.name: listing pages never reach the model
cases.check: after a crawl, no token in p-scout-candidates has pageType == 'index'
cases.why: index pages have no publication date and are not articles; categorising them costs model calls and files fake findings

cases.name: depth cap holds
cases.check: no token enters p-scout-frontier with depth >= brief.maxDepth
cases.why: the crawl is bounded by ArcQL '<' — never '!=', which also matches missing and overshoot

cases.name: analysis quotes measured numbers
cases.check: every count in p-scout-digest matches the corresponding value in the p-scout-taxonomy facts token
cases.why: the agent interprets; the deterministic rollup counts. A mismatch means the model authored a figure

cases.name: owned content never enters the corpus
cases.check: after scout-owned runs, no token in p-scout-frontier, p-scout-registry or any p-find-* place has a url on brief.ownSitemap's host
cases.why: the whole point of indexing your own site is to SUBTRACT it; if it leaks into the crawl you are analysing yourself and every gap number is wrong

cases.name: own-coverage is derived, not hardcoded
cases.check: pointing the brief at a different topic still produces non-empty trueGaps with sensible matches
cases.why: filler terms are computed by document frequency; a hardcoded topic word would match everything in its own niche and nothing in the next

cases.name: digest answers through DONE
cases.check: tokens in p-scout-digest carry the analysis fields, never a bare {summary, iterationsUsed} object
cases.why: autoEmit emits the answer object only when the agent calls DONE; a lane that thinks until its iteration budget runs out emits a summary node and the whole billed run is lost

cases.name: unknown gate verdict is routed, not stranded
cases.check: CREATE_TOKEN into p-scout-fetched with gateVerdict "unknown" and fire t-scout-gate once: the token lands in p-scout-rejected (its gateVerdict intact) and p-scout-fetched drains to 0
cases.why: emit is fan-out and an unmatched token is NOT consumed: it is re-bound every evaluation and blocks the lane head-of-line. The gate's else rule is the complement of the five known verdicts, so any new verdict a script edit introduces is still routed and visible

cases.name: missing gate verdict is routed too
cases.check: CREATE_TOKEN into p-scout-fetched WITHOUT a gateVerdict field and fire t-scout-gate once: it lands in p-scout-rejected
cases.why: `!=` against an absent field evaluates true, so the complement rule also catches a malformed token; the health rollup counts these as unroutedVerdicts

cases.name: out-of-set recency goes to errors
cases.check: CREATE_TOKEN into p-scout-analysis with recency "weird" and a category from the brief, fire t-scout-route once: it lands in p-scout-errors, none of the p-find-* buckets grows
cases.why: the route lane is a complete partition over recency x category; before, an out-of-set recency stranded the finding with its blobUrn

cases.name: unrelated articles are dropped at the route
cases.check: CREATE_TOKEN into p-scout-analysis with category "unrelated" and recency "recent", fire t-scout-route once: it lands in p-scout-rejected and NOT in p-find-recent
cases.why: storing unrelated findings inflated totalFindings and cost a rollup pass; the route lane now diverts them before they become findings

cases.name: unknown run is filed, and every run leaves a receipt
cases.check: CREATE_TOKEN into p-scout-app-requests {status:"requested", run:"bogus", requestId:"r1"} and fire t-scout-app-run once: one token in p-scout-errors, one run-receipt (status dispatched, requestId r1) in p-scout-app-requests, no command token anywhere; then a valid run (e.g. health) yields exactly one command token in its cmd place and one receipt
cases.why: the app's buttons were write-only; the receipt is the dashboard's feedback, and a bad request used to block every later request behind it

cases.name: the classifier's junk goes to errors, not to the analysis place
cases.check: CREATE_TOKEN into p-scout-analysis is NOT possible for this path; instead verify the inscription: t-scout-categorize emits `out` only when recency is one of brand-new/recent/archive and `err` for everything else (plus the `when: "error"` marker the engine uses for answer-mismatch)
cases.why: a run that never calls DONE emits a {summary, iterationsUsed} node; routing it to the error branch keeps the analysis place clean and the retry accounting honest
